name: BilloraOne Connector
author: Ravikas

sections.description:
Connect your WordPress or WooCommerce website with BilloraOne to manage billing, inventory, ecommerce, customers, and business operations from one cloud platform.

Partner with BilloraOne

Turn your network into income with BilloraOne’s powerful partner ecosystem.

  • Referral Program
  • Sales Partner Program
  • White Label Partner Program

Join, refer, sell, and earn recurring commissions while helping businesses grow.

BilloraOne is a complete cloud-based business management platform that helps retailers, wholesalers, and growing businesses manage their entire business from one place.

Instead of using multiple plugins and software, BilloraOne brings everything together, including billing, inventory, ecommerce, accounting, customer management, marketing, and AI-powered automation.

The WordPress Connector securely links your website with your BilloraOne account. All business data stays in BilloraOne while your website displays products, customer information, and other connected features through secure APIs.

Requires an active BilloraOne account. Storefront embeds, WooCommerce sync, and insights widgets depend on your BilloraOne plan. This is a SaaS service requirement, not a paid unlock inside the plugin.

Perfect for

  • Grocery stores and supermarkets
  • Fashion and electronics shops
  • Mobile and hardware stores
  • Furniture stores and gift shops
  • Restaurants and cafés
  • Wholesale businesses
  • Any retail or service business

Why choose BilloraOne?

Manage your entire business from a single platform:

  • POS billing
  • GST invoicing
  • Inventory management
  • Purchase management
  • Customer management
  • Supplier management
  • Multi-store support
  • Barcode management
  • Ecommerce integration
  • Free business website
  • WordPress integration
  • Membership and loyalty programs
  • Reward points and wallet
  • AI SEO blogging
  • Google Business Profile integration
  • Marketing automation
  • Business reports and analytics
  • Cloud backup and security

What this plugin does

The BilloraOne Connector is a lightweight integration plugin that securely connects your WordPress website with BilloraOne. Using this plugin you can:

  • Connect your website in minutes
  • Start a free trial
  • Securely authenticate your website
  • Sync products and customers
  • Display BilloraOne products and categories
  • Receive real-time updates through secure APIs
  • Monitor connection status
  • Manage your website from BilloraOne

No complex configuration required.

Secure and fast

This plugin does not duplicate your business logic. BilloraOne remains the single source of truth while WordPress connects securely using APIs. This keeps your website fast, secure, and easy to maintain.

Getting started

  1. Install the plugin.
  2. Activate it.
  3. Connect your BilloraOne account.
  4. Start your 14-day free trial.
  5. Manage your business from BilloraOne.

Support

  • Website: https://billoraone.com
  • Documentation: https://billoraone.com/docs
  • Partner program: https://billoraone.com/partners
  • Whitelabel partner program: https://billoraone.com/whitelabel-partner

External services

This plugin connects to BilloraOne APIs to provide its functionality. Data is sent only after a site administrator connects the site.

Service: BilloraOne (https://billoraone.com)

What is sent:

  • On connect: site URL, return URL, one-time OAuth code exchange
  • While connected: site token, tenant ID, site ID, plugin version
  • Heartbeat (twice daily): WordPress version, PHP version, WooCommerce version, theme name, timezone, locale, currency
  • Woo bridge setup: WooCommerce REST consumer key/secret, webhook secret, store URL
  • Storefront embeds: product catalog queries (read-only) for shortcodes/blocks
  • Customer login shortcode: email and password submitted to BilloraOne storefront customer APIs (browser → BilloraOne; not stored in WordPress)
  • Inbound catalog webhooks from BilloraOne (signed) to refresh local caches

When data is sent: After an administrator clicks Connect with BilloraOne, and whenever connected features run (sync, shortcodes, heartbeat, customer login).

Default API endpoint: https://billoraone.com/api/v1 (overridable in plugin settings)

Terms and privacy: See BilloraOne Terms and BilloraOne Privacy on the BilloraOne website.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce (required for order webhooks and product sync).
  2. Upload and activate BilloraOne Connector.
  3. In WordPress admin, go to BilloraOne → Advanced and set your BilloraOne app URL if you use a white-label portal.
  4. Click Connect with BilloraOne while logged into your BilloraOne store admin.
  5. After authorization, use Sync products to Woo or add BilloraOne shortcodes to pages.

You can also download the latest ZIP from BilloraOne → Connect → WordPress in your BilloraOne dashboard.
sections.faq:
Do I need a BilloraOne subscription?

Yes. BilloraOne is a cloud business platform, and this connector links your WordPress or WooCommerce site to your BilloraOne workspace. Start with a 14-day free trial, then keep the plan that includes the modules you need (WooCommerce sync, product display, insights, and more). This is a SaaS service requirement, not a paid unlock inside the plugin.

Does this replace WooCommerce?

No. WooCommerce stays on your WordPress site when you sell there. BilloraOne handles billing, inventory, customers, and operations in the cloud while this plugin syncs products and customers, receives order webhooks, and keeps everything connected. You run your business from BilloraOne without maintaining two separate catalogs.

Where does checkout happen?

It depends how you sell. Checkout on your WordPress store runs through WooCommerce, and orders are sent to BilloraOne automatically. If you direct shoppers to your BilloraOne storefront, checkout happens on your BilloraOne domain. Either way, BilloraOne remains your central system for inventory, billing, and customer records.

Is my data stored in WordPress?

BilloraOne is the single source of truth for products, inventory, customers, and business data. WordPress only stores connection tokens, WooCommerce bridge credentials, and short-lived catalog cache. Sensitive business records stay in BilloraOne, and customer passwords are not stored in WordPress when using BilloraOne storefront login features.

Can I use a custom BilloraOne domain?

Yes. For white-label portals or partner environments, open BilloraOne → Advanced and set your BilloraOne app URL and BilloraOne API base. Your site will connect to your branded BilloraOne workspace instead of the default billoraone.com endpoints.

How can I partner with BilloraOne?

BilloraOne offers several partner paths. Join the Referral Program to earn from referrals, the Sales Partner Program to promote BilloraOne with commissions, or the White Label Partner Program to resell the platform under your own brand and pricing.

Is setup complicated?

No. Install and activate the plugin, click Connect with BilloraOne, and authorize your workspace. Product sync, customer sync, and connection monitoring work through secure APIs with no complex server configuration.

0.3.8

0.3.7

0.3.6

0.3.5

  • High-contrast connect / disconnect admin notices.

  • Tested up to WordPress 7.0; translations load via WordPress.org when listed.

0.3.1

  • Account shortcode shows recent Billora storefront orders after sign-in (not only links).
  • Categories shortcode links each category to the Billora shop category page.
  • Clarifies that WooCommerce My Account orders are separate from Billora storefront orders.

0.3.0

  • Refreshed admin UI with Billora brand orange (#FC5504).
  • Friendly errors when Billora API returns 502 HTML instead of dumping the gateway page.

0.2.9

  • Add “Generate all shortcode pages” to create Shop, On Sale, Search, Categories, Store Links, Login, and Account pages in one click.

0.2.8

0.2.7

0.2.6

0.2.5
